name: Brandweerkazerne Hendrik
description: The curved brick station at Rozengracht and Marnixstraat has five red vehicle doors, a swept mansard roof and a long clerestory ribbon.
funFact: Hendrik opened at this corner in1985. Its name retains the H of the Huiszittenhuis, the former station at Prinsengracht237. A1685 relief of Saint Victor remembers the mill that once stood here. After major renovation and energy upgrades, the station reopened on6November2025.
